forcedBody: This version is no longer supported. Please update to keep using Ritme.
installBody: Install Ritme on your home screen for quick access.
iosStep1: 1. Tap the Share button in Safari's bottom bar
iosSignInNote: The installed app asks you to sign in once; after that you stay signed in.
inAppBody: This page is open inside another app's browser. Use its ⋯ menu to open it in Safari or Chrome, so you can install Ritme and stay signed in.
